title: Classify a text
summary: Choose one label from a list for a short text, with a reason.

inputs.text: I was charged twice this month.
The app crashes when I log in.

sections.use: Sort short texts such as support messages or feedback into one of your labels, with a reason.
sections.exclusions: One label only; not for multi-label tagging or long documents.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 16,384 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 512 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Text up to 8,000 characters; 2 to 20 labels. The output contract cannot check that the label is in your list; for a fixed label set, edit the label output to a Choice of those labels, so a non-member is refused and repaired.
sections.missing_data: Empty or unclear text gets the closest label, usually other, with a reason saying so.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

inputs.labels: The allowed labels, a JSON list of 2 to 20 strings.

outputs.label: One label, copied exactly from the list.
